summary: Configuration as Code manages AAP configuration in version-controlled YAML or JSON. All CasC playbooks must authenticate through platform gateway (aap_hostname = gateway URL); direct component APIs and legacy controller PATs are not supported. Prerequisites: Git, gateway access, a gateway token or credentials, and an EE with ansible.platform.
questions: What is Configuration as Code for AAP?
Can CasC playbooks talk to automation controller directly?
Do controller PATs work with ansible.platform?
